exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to give, to impart; to attach
to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute
to hand over, to deliver, to give
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: придава́ть — to give, to impart; to attach; вы́дать — to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute; передава́ть — to hand over, to deliver, to give; изда́ть — to publish, to print.
**выдал** — вы́дать (perfective): to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute; to produce; to deliver up, to give up, to extradite; to betray, to give away. Wiktionary: вы- + дать.
